issue_request: FHIR-32766 was Published/Persuasive for R5. It reported missing bindings on CodeableReference elements, specifically Ingredient.item, and its resolution required an example binding to SNOMED CT Medication codes plus a MedicationKnowledge IndicationGuideline.indication fix.
initial_application: The FHIR-32766-tagged commit 3eb5717dff added the medication-codes example binding to Medication.ingredient.item, and that binding remains present in the active Medication source. MedicationKnowledge.indicationGuideline.indication never received a binding, but the current build no longer includes MedicationKnowledge as an active resource.
additional_context: May 2021 Pharmacy WGM minutes confirm the FHIR-32766 vote, the Ingredient.item binding rationale, and that MedicationKnowledge was the other resource to address. Later source history removed MedicationKnowledge from active resource build scope in commit 5a4307d78b, deleting its active [resources], abbreviation, approval, and mappings entries from source/fhir.ini. The stale source/medicationknowledge folder still exists, but source/fhir.ini is the build-scope authority for this reconciliation.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active current Medication.ingredient.item binding is already correct, and the remaining MedicationKnowledge target is outside the current build. An immediately preceding unkeyed correction commit reverted an out-of-scope worker edit to the stale MedicationKnowledge source file.
